name: Restoran 010 — Servis kat/masa planı açılır
description: Demo Restoran (010) Restoran kabuğunda Günü başlat (gerekirse) + Servis; garson/PIN sonrası kat/masa planı.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Restoran (010), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the top shell module labeled Restoran
If the fiscal day is closed and Günü başlat is visible, click Günü başlat; if the day is already open, skip this
Click the dashboard tile labeled Servis
If a waiter or staff PIN selection modal appears, select an available staff and confirm to enter the floor
Verify the restaurant Servis floor is active with table cards, Masa labels, or Masa durumu indicators — not only the main Restoran dashboard tile grid
